nodes.text: @SAHILBERWALJi There are worrying reports from China about human metapneumovirus (HMPV) infections, particularly affecting young children. The virus causes respiratory problems, and its symptoms are similar to those of COVID-19, such as cough, fever, and nasal congestion.
